|lead='''It Is The Future You See''' is a [[Light]] [[Jedi Test]] released as a very-rare foil in [[Reflections]] in January 2000.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 28–32 (collecting compilation). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> It is a foil printing of the [[Dagobah]] card.<ref name="foil-face">[[:File:Reflections-Foil-L-It-Is-The-Future-You-See-PSA-photo-181170648-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections foil face]], Robert John.</ref>
|game_text='''Deploy''' on a Dagobah site. '''Target''' a mentor on Dagobah and an apprentice who has completed Jedi Test #4. '''Attempt''' when apprentice is present at the beginning of your control phase. Turn apprentice upside down (cannot move and power = 0). At the end of your next turn, turn apprentice right side up (restored):<br />'''Place''' on apprentice. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. Reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and place one upside down on apprentice. Whenever you are about to draw a card for destiny, you may instead use the upside-down card (which remains on apprentice for re-use).<ref name="foil-face" />
